question: What experiential and transformative results arise from this visualization practice?
premises: The visualized figure plays with various enjoyments.
A form according to wish also arises.
These are presented as outcomes of the practice.
inference: Through this visualization one experiences various enjoyments and attains a form according to wish.
uncertainties: It is ambiguous whether the subject of both verbs is the deity or the practitioner.
plain_english: He plays with various enjoyments and also takes on a form according to his wish.
